nuances.title: Bemused vs Amused
nuances.meaning: Bemused means puzzled or bewildered, while amused means finding something funny or entertaining.
nuances.nuance_explanation: Though often mistakenly used to mean mildly entertained, 'bemused' actually carries a sense of being lost in thought or slightly confused by a perplexing situation.
nuances.example_usage: She looked bemused by the complex instructions left by the appliance repair technician.
